---
title: "HPA lab practical 1"
author: "Zoe Haighton"
---
I am calculating the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in pigs, mice and humans using the sum function 

First, I will calculate the total number of elevated genes in the forebrain (cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus) in Humans
```{r}
sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
```

Now, I will do the same for pigs
```{r}
sum(109, 157, 31, 45 )
```

Finally, I will calculate the total number of regionally elevated genes in the forebrain of mice
```{r}
sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
```

Overall, humans were the species that had the highest number of regionally elevated genes in the forebrain
